title: Vertex type of a gate
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, let $n,V$ be natural numbers, and let $g$ be a gate such that gate number $V-n$ in the circuit for input length $n$ is $g$, with $n\le V$. For any optional gate kind $t$, the vertex $V$ lies below the circuit size and has type $t$ if and only if the gate kind of $g$, as an optional value, equals $t$.
hypotheses_covered: gate number $V-n$ in the circuit for length $n$ is $g$
